# Browser fixture (tests/fixtures/editor.html), freshly opened. The first tap
# comes before any query of ours, so the browser's accessibility support is
# started by KeyFlip.
layout:en
key:tab
type:ghbdtn
tap:alt
expect:привет
expect-layout:ru
show
tap:alt
expect:ghbdtn
expect-layout:en
tap:ctrl
expect:GHBDTN
tap:ctrl
expect:ghbdtn
# A word that was not typed just now: UI Automation, paste, verification.
key:end
tap:alt
expect:привет
tap:alt
expect:ghbdtn
# Trailing space in a multi-line field.
key:tab
key:ctrl+end
show
tap:alt
expect:first привет\s
expect-layout:ru
tap:alt
expect:first ghbdtn\s
expect-layout:en
# A typed word after existing text.
type:ntcn
tap:alt
expect:first ghbdtn тест
tap:alt
expect:first ghbdtn ntcn
# Selection in a contenteditable.
key:tab
key:ctrl+a
show
tap:ctrl
contains:GHBDTN
key:ctrl+a
tap:alt
contains:ПРИВЕТ
